data.gender_notes: Sunetra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sunetra is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sunetra’ which means ‘dawn’, ‘radiant’, ‘bright’, and ‘clear’. This name is inspired by the beautiful and clear dawn and is considered to be a symbol of positivity and hope. The name Sunetra carries the meaning “Dawn, Radiant, Bright, Clear” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sunetra usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, radiant, bright, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sunetra is a divine name that is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and success in life. It is also believed to bestow the blessings of the Sun God and the Goddess of Dawn, offering protection, wisdom, and inner peace.
data.etymology: Sunetra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dawn, Radiant, Bright, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunetra total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
